channels.name: DQ
channels.purpose: Single data line carrying time-slot-encoded bits (Reset / Presence / Write / Read slots), the 64-bit ROM ID address phase, ROM and Function command bytes, and data bytes — plus optional parasitic power delivery to slaves during HIGH periods.
channels.active_levels: HIGH = released (pulled to VDD by Rp, typically 4.5-5.5 V); LOW = any device pulls below VIL (~0.8 V).
channels.drive_type: open-drain (master FET pulldown; slave open-drain; both rely on shared external Rp for HIGH).

channels.name: GND
channels.purpose: Return path for DQ current; shared ground reference for master and all slaves.

handshake_pairs.name: RESET_PRESENCE
handshake_pairs.rule: Master holds DQ LOW ≥ tRSTL; slaves respond with Presence Pulse 15-60 µs after master release.

handshake_pairs.name: WRITE_SLOT
handshake_pairs.rule: Master pulls LOW 1-15 µs (Write-1) or ≥ 60 µs (Write-0); slave samples within its valid window.

handshake_pairs.name: READ_SLOT
handshake_pairs.rule: Master pulls LOW 1-15 µs and releases; slave drives LOW (for 0) or releases (for 1); master samples at tMSR.

handshake_pairs.name: MATCH_ROM_DROPOUT
handshake_pairs.rule: If master's transmitted ROM-ID bit ≠ slave's own bit, slave silently drops out of the current transaction.

handshake_pairs.name: SEARCH_ROM_BIT_PAIR
handshake_pairs.rule: Slaves drive bit then complement in successive Read slots; (0,0) signals discrepancy; master writes back chosen path.

handshake_pairs.name: CRC8_INTEGRITY
handshake_pairs.rule: Final byte of ROM ID and selected payloads is CRC-8 of preceding bytes; master verifies.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Master initiates every time slot by pulling DQ LOW; slaves never drive DQ except during Presence Pulse (immediately after Reset) and Read slots (in response to master's leading LOW pulse).
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Every bit's interpretation depends on master's slot type (Write-0 / Write-1 / Read) AND on whether master or slave drives DQ during the 60-µs window.
dependency_graph.addressing_dependency: Function commands have no effect until ROM-command address resolution selects a slave (Match ROM / Skip ROM / Search ROM / Resume).
dependency_graph.integrity_dependency: CRC-8 trailer on ROM ID and selected function-command payloads is the only protocol-level integrity check; bytes have no per-byte ACK.

optional_channels.name: VDD
optional_channels.purpose: Optional separate power pin for non-parasitic-powered slaves (preferred for high-current operations like temperature conversion or EEPROM write).

logical_signal_states.name: released
logical_signal_states.rule: Pulled to VDD via Rp; default bus state.

logical_signal_states.name: driven
logical_signal_states.rule: Master or any slave pulls DQ below VIL; wired-AND across all open-drain drivers.

ordering_rules.field_order_within_rom_id: Family code (8 bits) → Serial number (48 bits) → CRC-8 (8 bits), each field LSB-first within its bytes.
ordering_rules.transaction_order: Reset → Presence → ROM command → [64-bit ROM ID for Match/Search] → Function command → data bytes.
